draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and grounded, pointing out a basic physical part
notes: The plural is 'benen' for legs, and 'beenderen' for bones of the skeleton.
For a single bone (especially in food or for a dog), 'het bot' is much more common in everyday speech than 'het been'.
Used for human legs (and horses); for most other animals, use 'de poot'.
